name: WhatsApp Nov fixes
tile_line: An IP leak, a tap-needed bug and a Meta-internal one.
tldr: WhatsApp disclosed three bugs on 20 Nov 2026. One could reveal your IP address to a scammer and may have been abused with spam; one needs you to tap a message from an unofficial client, the other an attacker inside Meta. Update the app as usual.
summary: The IP leak came through a crafted ad-reply message and is fixed in 2.26.17.4. Meta says it has seen no sign either of the other two was exploited.

status.needs: a WhatsApp account to message you; the Meta AI bug instead needs a position inside Meta's infrastructure

affected.label: WhatsApp older than its fix
affected.text: The IP address bug (CVE-2026-23871) is in WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business for Android from 2.20.198.3, before 2.26.17.4. The order-message bug (CVE-2026-102769) is in WhatsApp for Android before 2.26.35.74; its description names only WhatsApp for Android, but the same record also lists WhatsApp Business for Android from 2.22.3.7, before 2.26.35.74. The Meta AI bug (CVE-2026-44908) is in WhatsApp for iOS before 2.26.24.72, WhatsApp Business for iOS and WhatsApp for Mac before 2.26.23.72, WhatsApp for Android before 2.26.23.74 and WhatsApp Business for Android before 2.26.23.70.

affected.label: An attacker in the right position
affected.text: For the IP address bug, that's anyone who can send you a crafted Click to WhatsApp ad-reply message: once it's shown in a chat, your phone can fetch media from the attacker's server and reveal your IP address. For the order-message bug, you have to tap a crafted "order details" message sent from an unofficial WhatsApp client; it can delete WhatsApp's own locally stored files, and leak one bit of information about your chat database if you're online when it arrives. For the Meta AI bug, the attacker has to be inside Meta's infrastructure, and Meta says a third-party transparency ledger confirms no exploitation.

do.label: Update WhatsApp from the store
do.text: Versions with every fix that applies to each app: WhatsApp for Android 2.26.35.74, WhatsApp for iOS 2.26.24.72, WhatsApp Business for iOS and WhatsApp for Mac 2.26.23.72. For WhatsApp Business for Android, sources conflict: HKCERT gives 2.26.23.70 (the Meta AI fix), but the CVE record for the order-message bug lists Business for Android as affected before 2.26.35.74, so get 2.26.35.74 or later.

do.label: Why it isn't Patch now
do.text: Attacks were reported only for the IP address bug, and it only reveals an IP address: Meta rates it 3.5 (Low). WhatsApp says it may have been abused with spam messages, and a spokesperson told SecurityWeek "we believe a scammer was using it to make their scam message seem more credible". HKCERT says it is being exploited in scattered cases, while CISA's early assessment in the CVE records says no exploitation for all three. Meta rates the other two 6.8 and 4.8 (Medium), and its score for the order-message bug says working exploit code exists; no source links to public code. None of the three is on CISA's list of exploited bugs.

versions_skip: No release feed we track for WhatsApp; the fixed version for each app is in the steps.
